																	General Intelligence and Reasoning

																	Mathematics
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning

																Marking Scheme:
																
																	General Awareness: 50 Questions
																	Mathematics: 35 Questions
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
																	Total Marks: 120

																Economy
																General Science
																Environmental Issues

																Number Systems

																Trigonometry
																Mensuration
																Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)

																Analogies
																Blood Relations
																Coding-Decoding
																Syllogism
																Direction Sense
																Decision Making
